definition: The process of selecting, filtering, cleaning, and organizing data to improve its quality and suitability for training or evaluation.
details: Data curation has become increasingly recognized as a critical lever for model quality, sometimes rivaling model architecture and scale in its impact on final performance.
story: Think of a historian sorting through boxes of letters, building a picture of an era one sentence at a time. Here is the short version: The process of selecting, filtering, cleaning, and organizing data to improve its quality and suitability for training or evaluation. The part that makes it sing: Data curation has become increasingly recognized as a critical lever for model quality, sometimes rivaling model architecture and scale in its impact on final performance. The words a model reads become the world it believes in. And that is Data Curation — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
